title: Allicin inhibits kidney stone formation by suppressing the TNF/NF-kappaB pathway: Experimental validation through network pharmacology, in vitro, and in vivo studies.
authors: Peng, Zechun; Xu, Mingbin; Yang, Jie; He, Shuming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大蒜素通过TNF/NF-kappaB通路抑制肾结石形成，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Nephrolithiasis is a prevalent urological disorder characterized by significant incidence and frequent recurrence. Allicin has diverse pharmacological effects; however, its precise function and underlying mechanisms in reducing kidney stone formation have not been thoroughly investigated. The present research endeavors to comprehensively examine the impact of allicin on the development of renal calculi and elucidate its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: A multifaceted methodology was implemented, incorporating network pharmacology for target and pathway identification, molecular docking to evaluate binding affinities, in vitro experiments utilizing calcium oxalate-damaged HK-2 cells for assessing cellular responses, and in vivo investigations employing ethylene glycol-induced nephrolithiasis rat model to examine physiological impacts. RESULTS: Integrated network pharmacological screening identified 46 overlapping targets shared by allicin and nephrolithiasis. Among these hub molecules, TNF was recognized as the central effector target, and the TNF/NF‑kappaB signaling axis was determined as the dominant pathway mediating the protective effects of allicin against renal crystal formation. Molecular docking confirmed that allicin moderately binds to TNF (binding energy of -2.05 kcal/mol). In vitro, allicin (200 micromol/L) improved the viability of injured HK-2 cells and decreased the levels of inflammatory factors. In vivo, allicin reduced kidney damage and calcium oxalate deposition in rats. CONCLUSION: Allicin alleviates kidney stones by inhibiting the TNF/NF-kappaB pathway, providing preclinical evidence for its potential in kidney stone management. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: Not applicable.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：肾结石是一种常见的泌尿系统疾病，具有显著发病率和频繁复发的特点。大蒜素具有多种药理作用；然而，其在减少肾结石形成中的确切功能及潜在机制尚未被深入研究。本研究旨在全面探讨大蒜素对肾结石发展的影响，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：采用多层面方法，包括网络药理学用于靶点和通路识别、分子对接以评估结合亲和力、利用草酸钙损伤的HK-2细胞进行体外实验以评估细胞反应，以及采用乙二醇诱导的肾结石大鼠模型进行体内研究以检查生理影响。结果：综合网络药理学筛选确定了46个大蒜素与肾结石共有的重叠靶点。在这些核心分子中，TNF被识别为中枢效应靶点，TNF/NF-kappaB信号轴被确定为介导大蒜素对肾晶体形成保护作用的主要通路。分子对接证实大蒜素与TNF中等程度结合（结合能为-2.05 kcal/mol）。体外实验中，大蒜素（200微摩尔/升）改善了受损HK-2细胞的活力，并降低了炎症因子水平。体内实验中，大蒜素减轻了大鼠的肾损伤和草酸钙沉积。结论：大蒜素通过抑制TNF/NF-kappaB通路缓解肾结石，为其在肾结石管理中的潜力提供了临床前证据。临床试验注册：不适用。
